reviews.title: Great for gaming, comfortable for cats
reviews.comment:
This mousepad feels amazing to play on. I use a Model O 2 wireless mouse and it glides so smooth on this mousepad.
The real important information though is how your cat will stand up to this. Well I've had the Scabbard II extended for 2 months and in the very beginning she clawed it a couple of times but minor and she doesn't really claw it anymore after she realized how comfortable it is to sleep on it. This mousepad is big enough to do her big stretch when she sleeps and still have mousepad left over to game.  She still bites the edges from time to time when she's bored but its nowhere near as bad as getting your mousepad clawed since your mouse glides over it.

reviews.title: Excellent pad!
reviews.comment: I love this mouse pad! I am disabled and can't really sit at my desk for long periods and sit mostly in a recliner. To use my PC I had to move it to my coffee table in front of my recliner. I got this pad and a board matching it's dimensions from Amazon so I could use my PC from my recliner and the setup works very well, and this pad works excellent with my ASUS wireless keyboard and Spatha X mouse.
